\caption{Accuracy and biomarker preservation do not peak at the same checkpoint. Validation CT Dice (left) rises to a plateau, while the MTV and TLG bias (right) reach their optimum roughly halfway through level-3 training and degrade thereafter. The dashed line marks the checkpoint selected by Eq.~\eqref{eq:score}. Faint lines are the per-round values, solid lines a centred rolling mean.}
\label{fig:selection}
\end{figure}
